contract.title: Contract Signature and Confirmation
contract.subtitle: Complete the digital authentication requirements to start agricultural Escrow custody
contract.clause1: FIRST CLAUSE: Subject of the Lease
contract.clause1Body: The Farmer grants the Merchant a temporary lease of {{area}} of cultivable land, named {{name}}, intended for the planned production of {{crops}}. Soil fertility and irrigation-water specifications are detailed in the Allpatek climate-viability annex.
contract.clause2: SECOND CLAUSE: Payment Plan and Escrow Milestones
contract.clause2Body: The agreed amount of {{cost}} will be held in the digital custody vault managed by Allpatek. Funds are released in four successive 25% disbursements after milestone verification:
contract.clause3Body: Every request by the Farmer to release money requires georeferenced photographic evidence and Allpatek inspection signatures. The Merchant has a maximum of 5 business days to file a formal objection; otherwise the funds are released automatically under the Escrow mandate.
contract.m2Rest: Sowing and germination (satellite verification or photographic evidence).
contract.m3Rest: Crop development and first supervised technical pruning.
contract.m4Rest: Harvest and final delivery at the commercial logistics warehouse.
contract.drawHint: PNG or JPG. Click or drop the file.
contract.signatureError: Choose a PNG or JPG image of your signature.
contract.accept: I accept the Escrow custody terms and conditions
contract.acceptHint: By proceeding with the electronic signature, you formally authorize Allpatek to act as the withholding and release agent for the funds according to verified milestone compliance.
contract.sent: Contract sent for the farmer to accept.
contract.note: Once signed, the contract is activated and the funds are deposited in Escrow custody.

escrow.title: Payment Vault
escrow.subtitle: Custody management and release of funds by contractual milestones
escrow.actionBody: The "{{milestone}}" milestone requires your approval to release the funds.
escrow.readyBody: The evidence for "{{milestone}}" was accepted. Authorize the disbursement here.
escrow.reviewFirstBody: The evidence for "{{milestone}}" is still under review. Accept it before releasing the money.
escrow.lockedShare: It stays in custody until the evidence is accepted
escrow.addCardBody: Enter the money on your card. Each disbursement is deducted from that balance.
escrow.needCard: Add a card before authorizing the disbursement.
escrow.needFunds: The card balance is not enough for this milestone.
escrow.empty: There is no active contract in the vault yet.
escrow.approvedNote: Milestone accepted. That part of the payment is released and the farmer can send evidence for the next milestone.

deposit.title: Add card
deposit.subtitle: Enter the money you have and the card details. Disbursements are deducted from that balance.
deposit.constant: That amount is what you have now. Each milestone you authorize in the vault is deducted from it.
deposit.secure: Only the last 4 digits are stored. The full number and the CVV are not saved.
deposit.invalid: Enter an amount above zero, a 16-digit number, the MM/YY date, and the CVV.
deposit.failed: The card could not be saved. Check that the API is running on port 3000.
